findings.current: Los filtros aparecen cuando el terminal tiene al menos {width} columnas de ancho.
findings.proposed: Los filtros aparecen a partir de {width} columnas.
findings.reason: 76 cells at {width}=90 against en's 61. The string is painted into .library-view-status (height: 2, padding 1 0 0 0 — one content row, 1fr), and it is painted EXACTLY when the rail is hidden, i.e. below 90 columns. On a 61-75 column terminal the Spanish notice is clipped where the English still fits. The proposed wording is 50 cells and keeps the whole claim.
